mapper.sql: t.id, t.publicity_type, t.title, t.content, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.contact_email, t.status, t.publish_user_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(pu.real_name, ''), pu.nickname, pu.username) AS publish_user_name
FROM club_publicity t LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.id = t.publish_user_id AND pu.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_publicity (publicity_type, title, content, start_date, end_date, contact_email, status, publish_user_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{publicityType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{contactEmail}, #{status}, #{publishUserId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE club_publicity SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.publicity_type AS publicity_type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM club_publicity t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.publicity_type ORDER BY t.publicity_type
